analysis.summary: Management stated that JG Chemicals delivered its best-ever quarterly performance in Q1 FY27, reaching all-time new highs in quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. The company is experiencing robust demand across end-user applications such as tires, rubber, ceramics, pharmaceuticals, and specialty chemicals. Key capacity expansion projects, including the Dahej greenfield facility and Naidupeta brownfield expansion, are on track for commissioning in Q3 FY27. Furthermore, management highlighted ongoing R&D initiatives, new product developments like LabPure and JG-ZRA, and continuous supply chain security despite global disruptions. J.G.

guidance.claim: The company expects to commission Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production at the Dahej facility in Q3 FY27.
guidance.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: For the first full year of operations at the Dahej plant in FY28, utilization is targeted at a minimum of 50% to 60%.
guidance.quote: But I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects higher sales in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are continuing to witness strong demand in the current quarter as well and expect higher sales in the current quarter.

guidance.claim: Management expects to continue the strong performance momentum going forward.
guidance.quote: The current quarter is also witnessing strong performance and we expect to continue the strong momentum going forward

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.
guidance.quote: increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth across major vehicle categories in Q1 FY27 saw passenger vehicles grow up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, continuing into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted encouraging traction in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: ATMA reported volume growth across major vehicle categories in Q1 FY27, including PV, 2W, CV, and 3W.
demand_outlook.quote: As Per ATMA, Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories — PV +26.6% YoY, 2W +16.58% YoY, CV +16.48% YoY, 3W +11.32% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand from OEMs and replacement demand will aid future growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from the OEM’s coupled with strong replacement demand will aid future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility in Gujarat involves an investment of about INR100 crores for a capacity of over 40,000 MTA.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the Dahej greenfield capacity expansion in Gujarat, the company is progressing well with its 40,000 plus MTA zinc greenfield chemical facility in Dahej.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is progressing well with expected commissioning in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE as a wholly-owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield project and Naidupeta brownfield expansion are both expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR315.7 crores, with EBITDA at INR36.3 crores and a margin of 11.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company is neutral to zinc prices.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined installed capacity across manufacturing facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Once both phases of the Dahej plant are operational, combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: JGCL serves over 200 domestic customers and over 50 global customers in more than 10 countries.
orders_capacity.quote: today JGCL serves the requirements of over 200 domestic customers and over 50 global customers in more than 10 countries.

capital_allocation.claim: The payback period target for the Dahej plant and other contemplated capex is in the range of 3 to 4 years.
capital_allocation.quote: Usually in our company, we always look at a payback period of 3 to 4 years, and I think in our past, in the past, we have always been able to achieve that. So, going forward, our target for the Dahej plant as well as other capex plans that are currently being contemplated is in the range of 3 to 4 years, mostly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted recent supply chain disruptions in West Asia and globally.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the recent West Asia crisis, the Indian tyre majors are expanding their capacities to cater to the OEM demand.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej facility is targeted for commissioning in November of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 50% to 60% capacity utilization at Dahej in the first full year of operations.
management_commitments.quote: I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commercially start the recycled rubber project in the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And we hope that in the next 12 months, we should be able to commercially start this project

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% going forward.
management_commitments.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
